steps.action: Run the existing F-host guarded recovery script only; preserve exactly one canonical daemon and verify the four required receipts.

After fresh heartbeat/claim, fetch one official National LIDAR metadata archive using the exact fileDataSetId locators discovered in Increment 161; record response bytes, SHA-256, archive member list and native CRS before use.

Intersect all three BNG target points against the downloaded National LIDAR metadata in EPSG:27700 and record only returned polygon_id, dtm_fn, tilename, survey/date, resolution, supplied/latest fields.
Resolve Time Stamped DTM lineage independently; do not substitute National Programme metadata for historical time-stamped coverage.
Use an XML-capable client against the persistent WCS 2.0.1 endpoint; parse the real CoverageId, then DescribeCoverage, then GetCoverage for actual DTM1m pixels.
Resolve July 2026 HMLR INSPIRE polygons in native BNG and mask actual EA DTM bytes; exclude NoData and compute numeric statistics only from accepted pixels.
Use current OS Terrain50 productId Terrain50 to obtain actual TQ39/TQ59/TQ27 grid archives plus per-tile metadata; sample documented 50m pixel centres and crosscheck the EA result.
Verify port 8012 and mark manual action RESOLVED only after the four receipts, fresh claim, three exact lineage records, three accepted numeric EA samples and three OS crosschecks exist.
